description: Represents a purchased AWS Elemental MediaConnect offering that provides discounted pricing for a usage commitment.

ResourceSpecification.description: A definition of what is being billed for, including the type and amount.

ReservedBitrate.description: The amount of outbound bandwidth that is discounted in the offering.

ResourceType.description: The type of resource and the unit that is being billed for.

ReservationArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that MediaConnect assigns to the reservation when you purchase an offering.

OfferingArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the offering.

ReservationName.description: The name that you assigned to the reservation when you purchased the offering.

Start.description: The day and time that the reservation becomes active.

End.description: The day and time that this reservation expires.

Duration.description: The length of time that this reservation is active.

DurationUnits.description: The unit of measurement for the duration of the reservation.

CurrencyCode.description: The type of currency that is used for billing.

PricePerUnit.description: The cost of a single unit.

PriceUnits.description: The unit of measurement that is used for billing.
